name: Bitnet sovereign edge model (State of Utopia)

mentions.name: Bitnet sovereign edge model (State of Utopia)
mentions.description: This project fine-tunes Bitnet, an older 1 GB model, into a sovereign model that can run on the edge. The base model was ported from the original C++ and Python to run in webGPU, where it is already fast, and a 30-hour training run is underway on simple hardware through webGPU so that no trust or installation is required. Browser-based tools are being developed so citizens can easily further fine-tune the model straight from their browser.
mentions.audience: Citizens of the State of Utopia, who are meant to further fine-tune and run the model from their browsers.
mentions.source_excerpt: The State of Utopia[1] is currently fine-tuning an older 1 GB model called Bitnet, so that we have something beginning to have the shape of a sovereign model that can run on the edge. We think having model sovereignty is important for our citizens, and we are working on tools for them to easily further fine-tune the model straight from their browser. We are currently running a 30-hour training run on some simple hardware and through webGPU, so that no trust or installation is required.
